_note: What the active pet says on the adventures tab. It is the only voice in the game: sincerely innocent, cheerful, and it never understands what's really happening. Its EYES pick its personality; its ACCESSORY adds a little tic at the end of each line. Situations: idle (nothing going on), away (a trip is out), needs_you (a trip is waiting for a choice), someone_back (a trip is back, not welcomed yet), back_all / back_some / back_none (just welcomed a trip back), part_found (it brought parts), rumour (word of somewhere new, waiting for you to decide), spotted (a pet saw a new place on its trip). {place} {home} {sent} {lost} {rumour} {spot} {who} are filled in. Lines are picked at random. HINTS are what the active pet says under each option on a trip (never numbers): 'risk' has 5 steps from sure to scared, picked from the real chance; 'reward' has 4 steps from a crumb to something special, picked from what the option can give; 'home' is for going home, 'rest' for options that heal. 'bias' shifts how this personality reads risk (-1 always sounds surer, +1 more scared). {trip} is the pet on the trip. 'feeling' is the line on top of a trip: how the pet on the trip seems after the last event (start / good / bad / hurt). GRAFT is what your active pet says about a part being sewn onto it: 'risk' has 5 steps from sure to scared (from the real chance, with the same bias), then a 'success' or 'fail' line. 'at_work' is said after the list of what your pet did while you were busy (errands, packs).

On the trail: trail_part when the pet picks up a part, trail_part_quote on the part's card (from the pet that found it), trail_part_kept / trail_part_left after add to bag / leave it; {trip} is the pet on the trip.
